title: Derived event definition (derived/<name>.json), format version 1
description: One derived event. The key names are listed in include/match/modload/derived_definition_keys.hpp; a test compares both. A derived event is a core client event that the engine emits right after a base client event. It carries a cause: the base event. A window definition opens a window for a seat (uni:open_on) and closes it (uni:close_on). A block definition (uni:window_of, uni:block_on) fires when an event concerns the seat of the open window; the engine reads the window as it was before the base event. Only the uni mod defines derived events (loader check derived.id.namespace). A matcher and a seat field may read a payload field with the audience all only (semantic check derived.field.audience).

uni:format_version.description: Version of the file style. This build reads major version 1.

uni:emits.description: The core client event id that the engine emits.

uni:open_on.description: Window: a base event that matches one of these opens a window for the seat in its seat field, and the engine emits the event.

uni:close_on.description: Window: a base event that matches one of these closes the window when its seat field names the seat of the window.

uni:block_on.description: Block: a base event that matches one of these and names the seat of the open window makes the engine emit the event.

uni:window_of.description: Block: the full id of the window definition.

uni:tests.description: All tests must be true for the event to match.
All tests must be true for the event to match.

uni:seat_field.description: The payload field of the matched event that names a seat. It must have the audience all.
